provenance_note: Mined the same way as this project's warlock-forever spell pack: client rows read directly from a local clone of the MIT-licensed sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (data/spells.jsonl), cross-checked against foreverdb.net's own tooltip text for each spell (both checked, 2026-10-25, while beginning this project's Mage support - see research-notes/ for the fuller writeup). base_points for a direct effect is the row's own Effect.BasePoints, already the level-60 average per the same Effect::average() formula used throughout this project - not independently recomputed, confirmed by it matching foreverdb.net's own stated min-max midpoint exactly for every spell below (e.g. Fireball: BasePoints 483, tooltip '425 to 541', midpoint 483).

fireball.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 25306 'Fireball Rank 12'. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net: '425 to 541 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec' - midpoint 483 matches BasePoints exactly; 60/4 ticks = 15/tick matches the row's periodic BasePoints exactly.

scorch.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 10207 'Scorch Rank 7'. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net: '163 to 193 Fire damage' - midpoint 178 matches BasePoints exactly. Note: Forever rebalanced this down from Classic Era's 233-275 (foreverdb.net's own comparison line) - a real rebalance, not a mining error. Fire Vulnerability (the debuff Scorch applies via the Improved Scorch talent) is a separate client row, not an effect of this spell - see mage/fire.rs's own constants.

fire_blast.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 10199 'Fire Blast Rank 7' - CategoryCooldownMs 8000 is the row's own real cooldown field, not assumed. Cross-checked against foreverdb.net: '402 to 474 Fire damage' - midpoint 438 matches BasePoints exactly.

evocation.source: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine (MIT), data/spells.jsonl, spell id 12051 'Evocation' - DurationMs 8000 and CooldownMs 480000 are the row's own real fields. Mana restored is hand-computed in mage/mod.rs's evocation_mana() from foreverdb.net's own plain tooltip text ('mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%... Lasts 8 sec') rather than this row's own three raw Effects (BasePoints 1500/100/100 across two different Aura types this project didn't fully decode in the time available), the same 'trust the clear tooltip over an ambiguous raw encoding' call this project already made for a couple of warlock-forever's own entries - see that pack's own known_conflicts for the precedent.
